SELECT "date" as "Date", 
    plate_number as "Plate Number", 
    code as "Code", 
    tanker_capacity as "Capacity",
    (
        CASE WHEN trip_time1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time3 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time4 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time5 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time6 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time7 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time8 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time9 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time10 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time11 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time12 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time13 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time14 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time15 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time16 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time17 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time18 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time19 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time20 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) as "Number of Trips",
    (
        CASE WHEN trip_time1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time3 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time4 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time5 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time6 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time7 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time8 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time9 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time10 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time11 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time12 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time13 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time14 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time15 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time16 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time17 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time18 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time19 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN trip_time20 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) * tanker_capacity AS "Total Capacity"
FROM 
    user_tankerdata 
WHERE 
    form_id = 131
    AND "date" >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
    AND "date" < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
    AND $__timeFilter("date")
ORDER BY
"date" DESC;
